memory_update.text: CAMT should remain in the underfollowed HBM/advanced-packaging discovery lane because its inspection/metrology tools have explicit HBM and advanced-packaging evidence, including order evidence tied to a leading HBM manufacturer.

FORM should remain in the underfollowed lane as a probe-card/test bottleneck candidate; HBM has already become a large portion of reported DRAM probe-card revenue, but margin and customer concentration must be checked.
KLIC is a higher-uncertainty HBM bonding-equipment hypothesis; evidence of a first HBM system is promising but needs revenue materiality, repeat-order, and customer-qualification verification.

AMKR is best used as a reference OSAT/advanced-packaging capacity anchor, not the core underfollowed idea, because its size and policy visibility make it less likely to be ignored than smaller tool and test suppliers.

The most important next verification gap is not whether these companies touch HBM, but whether HBM/advanced packaging is material enough to drive revenue, margins, backlog, and customer qualification durability.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM and advanced-packaging second-order supplier node with a two-lane funnel: one reference packaging anchor and three underfollowed discovery candidates tied to probe cards, inspection/metrology, bonding, and advanced-packaging equipment. The main finding is that the cleanest underfollowed candidates are not obscure because HBM is hidden, but because their exposure sits one step away from the obvious HBM producers and can be masked by mixed semiconductor-equipment labels, cyclical end markets, or broader test/assembly businesses. Market-cap buckets reflect web finance data checked on 2026-06-14 and are approximate research filters, not valuation conclusions.
